name: Sleipnir — the Cuddle Bus
tagline: Bryn bought a hearth with wheels and named it after her own spirit animal. Torie renamed it within the week.
body:
BOUGHT IN ARC 3, and the most Bryn purchase in the entire ledger: a vehicle whose stated purpose was MOVING HER PEOPLE AROUND IN COMFORT. A hearth with wheels, built for piling into.

SHE NAMED IT SLEIPNIR. Her own spirit animal is Sleipnir — steady power, unwavering loyalty, chosen purpose — and she put that name on the thing that carries the family, which is either the least subtle or the most honest act of her life depending on how well you know her. She has never once explained it.

TORIE CALLS IT THE FUCK WAGON and has since the first week, and both names are canon. Only one of them gets said in front of guests.

SHE IS A DOUBLE DECKER, AND SHE WAS NOT ONE WHEN SHE ARRIVED. Bryn bought the chassis. BRYN AND BELLA BUILT WHAT IT BECAME — Abbi gremlined about the length until somebody did something about it, so the body was ELONGATED, and BELLA REDID THE ENTIRE UNDERCARRIAGE to carry what that added.

THE FIT-OUT: plush carpets underfoot, fridges stocked with electrolytes — the H.O.R.N.I. doctrine applied to a chassis, cold and salty in a woman's hand before she has to ask — and LOVESEATS THAT FOLD DOWN INTO BEDS, with enough floor between them that NO BED TOUCHES ANOTHER when every one of them is pulled out. That last clause is the entire design brief. Sixteen marriages, one vehicle, and nobody shares a wall.

SHE IS THE WHOLE TRANSPORT PLAN. Not a support vehicle and not a shuttle to a pullout — THE ONLY VEHICLE THE TRIP NEEDS, for the ridge as readily as for the back hundred and forty, because she was built to house everyone and that is the specification.
rules: Bought Arc 3. Named SLEIPNIR by Bryn, after her own spirit animal
THE FUCK WAGON is Torie's name and is equally canon
Carved side · fold-out loveseat beds · electrolyte fridges
SHE GOES WHERE THE FAMILY GOES, ridge included. She is the only vehicle the trip needs
